summary: Frontend integration/polish pass verified end-to-end. Routing, auth guards, 404 catch-all, PageTransition wrapper, Settings + Profile pages, Sidebar Profile/Settings nav items, login, theme toggle presence, Edit-name flow, and Sign out all work correctly. Visual smoke on /profile, /settings, /404, /dashboard looked clean in light mode (no color clashes, icons render, brand CSS vars applied). One minor spec deviation and one benign console warning noted.

integration_issues.issue: Spec says 'returns user to landing page' but signOut redirects to /login. Session IS cleared (re-visiting /profile also redirects to /login), so functionally correct — only the landing target differs from spec. If intended, update spec; otherwise change AuthContext.signOut navigation target to '/'.

action_items: (Optional) Align sign-out redirect with spec: currently goes to /login, spec says landing (/). Low priority — session is properly cleared either way.

(Low priority) Investigate the single Supabase 400 console error that appears on /profile and /dashboard load. App still renders correctly; likely a stats query against a sparsely-seeded table (e.g. empty master_capstone_projects). Not blocking but worth confirming no needed field is missing.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is clean: ErrorBoundary wraps everything, Suspense+RouteLoader fallback is in place, PageTransition wraps all routes, lazy imports are consistent. Good.
NotFoundPage.jsx uses inline <style> tag for keyframes — this works but means keyframes re-mount on each visit. Minor; acceptable since page is rare.
SettingsPage.jsx is self-contained and renders correctly with Sidebar. Good use of data-testid on every interactive/informational element.
PageTransition.jsx keys on pathname — correct approach for fresh mount per navigation. Respects prefers-reduced-motion. Good.
Sidebar correctly exposes data-testid="nav-profile" and data-testid="nav-settings"; both navigate correctly.
All data-testid attributes required by the spec were present and selectable — no missing testids had to be patched.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (14/14 spec items passed, 1 minor behavioural deviation)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing TEST_Quiz Enrollment seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Routing + auth integration pass is stable. Checked: public routes (/, /signup, /login) load unauthenticated; protected routes (/dashboard, /profile, /settings, /session/abc/start) redirect to /login when unauthenticated; /xyz-not-exist and /foo/bar both render NotFoundPage with testid not-found-page/title/back/home; 'Take me home' navigates to /; login with Supabase test creds lands on /dashboard; /profile shows TA avatar, email, Edit button opens name input, Preferences card with theme toggle present, Learning journey stats visible, Sign out button works; /settings shows coming-soon card, 3 roadmap items (testids 0,1,2), Go-to-Profile link; sidebar nav-profile and nav-settings both clickable + navigable; PageTransition wrapper present on every routed page. Sign-out ends at /login (spec hinted /). Benign Supabase 400 console error observed on authenticated pages — doesn't break UI.
